_README: KAMO daily reminder — live configuration. Edit this file, commit, push: GitHub Pages
serves it in a couple of minutes and every device picks it up on its next launch. No
enabled:false is the kill switch. It does not merely stop scheduling — it CANCELS what
is already pending, so the fortnight of reminders sitting in the queue stops too.
Anything invalid here is ignored field by field and falls back to what shipped in the
binary, so a typo costs you that one value, never the feature. Ranges are clamped:
hours 0-23 (start must be <= end), horizonDays 1-21, settleMs 0-15000.
The 7 message lines rotate by calendar date. requiresHistory:true lines are swapped for
firstHide until the user has finished at least one hide.
settingsRecovery is OFF. iOS never shows its permission prompt twice, so this is the
only way back for someone who tapped Don't Allow: a dialog offering to open Settings.
Switch it to true once daily_reminder_optin_outcome shows how many people are stuck
behind a denial — it is worth having and easy to overdo.
